newsitem.title: USA: Missouri panel to review school desegregation.
newsitem.headline: Missouri panel to review school desegregation.

text.p: Missouri legislative leaders have created a joint committee to decide how the state should proceed beyond the court-ordered desegregation of public schools in St. Louis and Kansas City.
The 18-member panel announced Thursday will review decentralization of school administrations, which programs to continue funding, redistribution of savings and transportation issues.
The committee is to complete its review by Dec. 15, Senate President Pro-Tem Bill McKenna said.
